error[ZBX-E0530]: the AWS identity may not get an ECR authorization token
  cause  the AWS identity may not call ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
  aws    AccessDeniedException
  perm   ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
  fix    allow ecr:GetAuthorizationToken on resource "*" in the role's policy
  more   zbx explain E0530
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0530.html
